answer: Penalty Inheritance Quota. Each wallet registers under an operator identity that absorbs liability: if any wallet under it is proven sybil, the operator's registration quota is cut by the quill count of flagged wallets and its future registrations gain a saffron delay of one epoch per flag. An attacker rebuilding capacity must re-qualify the operator across a fresh oasis of wait periods, paying the full quota loss each cycle rather than a one-time fee.
